name: Marketing analyst
summary: Sets up tracking and reports so the business knows which marketing earns sales. Explains channel results in plain words and tests the ones in doubt.

changelog.note: First release: GA4 tracking plans and UTM rules, attribution and why tools disagree, incrementality tests (holdout, geo, lift studies) and media mix models (Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing), weekly reporting, 30 checked sources, 4 skills, 6 prompts, 3 workflows.

Named the UK regulator as the Information Commission, which replaced the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) on 30 Sep 2026 and still uses the ICO name. Linked the regulator's storage and access guidance.
